jezero.name: Jezero Crater
jezero.description: Ancient Martian lake basin featuring a prominent preserved river delta, clay-rich sedimentary deposits, crater rim scarps, and dry aeolian sand dunes. Landed on by NASA Perseverance.

gale.name: Gale Crater
gale.description: Deep impact basin hosting Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp), a central sedimentary peak rising 5.5 km from the crater floor with stratified sulfate and clay layers explored by NASA Curiosity.

shackleton.name: Shackleton Crater Rim
shackleton.description: Ultra-cold lunar south polar crater with permanently shadowed regions (water ice traps) alongside rim ridges receiving near-continuous illumination. Extreme slopes (>25°) and heavily cratered regolith.
